The cylinder has a valve with a handle on top, and a base with horizontal slots, likely for ventilation or stability.
The surface shows significant wear, scratches, and rust, especially on the lower half and around the seams.
The cylinder is standing upright against a wall in an outdoor or semi-outdoor area with tiled flooring.
No visible brand, model, or capacity markings are readable in any photo.
The seller claims it is a 50kg industrial cylinder, but no such label or stamp is visible in the photos.
